---
title: "Analysis 2: PCA"
format: html
---

## Load libraries

```{r}
#| message: false
library("tidyverse")
library("broom")
```

## Load data

The wide file has about 30,000 gene columns, so each line is longer than
the default read buffer. The buffer is increased before reading.

```{r}
#| message: false
Sys.setenv("VROOM_CONNECTION_SIZE" = "5000000")

dat <- read_tsv("../data/03_dat_aug.tsv.gz")
```

## PCA

Genes with zero variance are removed first, otherwise scaling does not work.

```{r}
pca_fit <- dat |>
  select(starts_with("ENSG")) |>
  select(where(~ var(.x) > 0)) |>
  prcomp(scale. = TRUE)
```

## PC1 vs PC2

```{r}
pca_aug <- pca_fit |>
  augment(dat)

pca_condition <- pca_aug |>
  ggplot(aes(x = .fittedPC1, y = .fittedPC2, colour = condition)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(x = "PC1", y = "PC2", colour = "Condition",
       title = "PCA coloured by condition") +
  theme_minimal()

pca_condition

ggsave("../results/06_pca_condition.png", pca_condition,
       width = 6, height = 5)
```

```{r}
pca_gender <- pca_aug |>
  ggplot(aes(x = .fittedPC1, y = .fittedPC2, colour = gender)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(x = "PC1", y = "PC2", colour = "Gender",
       title = "PCA coloured by gender") +
  theme_minimal()

pca_gender

ggsave("../results/06_pca_gender.png", pca_gender,
       width = 6, height = 5)
```

## Variance explained

```{r}
pca_variance <- pca_fit |>
  tidy(matrix = "eigenvalues") |>
  filter(PC <= 10) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = PC, y = percent)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:10) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(x = "Principal component",
       y = "Variance explained",
       title = "Variance explained by the first 10 PCs") +
  theme_minimal()

pca_variance

ggsave("../results/06_pca_variance.png", pca_variance,
       width = 6, height = 4)
```
